name: The Unbroken
title: What Refuses to Break
description: The ruins around it are rubble — walls down, floors caved, nothing left standing on its own. The Unbroken is what happens when a chain of motion never lets that stillness catch up: swing into clean into lunge into jerk into thruster into snatch, one hand carrying the weight until it has nothing left, then the other hand taking it without a pause. Stop anywhere in that chain and you've already lost — not to the weight, but to the silence after it. The ruins are broken. The Hunter isn't allowed to be.
